faqs.question: How long does this Keratin Shampoo take to work?
faqs.answer: From the moment you start using your Keratin Shampoo for Hair Fall, the super ingredients like keratin protein and biotin will start revitalizing your scalp and your hair follicles. You will only notice a difference in hair volume, hair thickness, and hair texture over consistent use for 3 months.

faqs.question: Can I use this Hair fall shampoo daily?
faqs.answer: Though this Keratin Shampoo for Hair Fall contains the best list of ingredients for your hair, it is recommended not using it more than thrice each week. Shampooing your hair more than thrice a week amounts to over-shampooing which damages your follicles and makes your scalp dry.

faqs.question: Are there any side effects to this Keratin Shampoo for Hair Loss?
faqs.answer: Absolutely not. There are no side effects of this Keratin Shampoo for Hair Fall. It is safe to use and it is FDA approved. For best results, it is recommended not using a hairdryer after washing your hair with this keratin Hair fall Control Shampoo.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of the Keratin?
faqs.answer: All keratin products protect your hair from damage. Like all keratin products, a keratin shampoo also prevents your hair from further damage from day-to-day styling and exposure to harsh environmental elements. It is recommended using a Keratin shampoo to maintain the smoothness and strength of your hair. In doing so, the keratin protein of your keratin shampoo avoids frizzy hair. Hence, a keratin shampoo is best for all types of hair especially frizzy hair.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of the Biotin?
faqs.answer: topical treatments of Biotin bind the molecule to the hair, giving it an immediate effect of fullness. That is because applying a hair product with Biotin coats each strand, increasing its diameter, and strengthening each strand. By doing this, it prevents breakage and allows hair to grow longer because it’s not as prone to snapping off before reaching your desired length.
